paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Saul kiang a thu agen khit in Jonathan hinna leh David hinna ahong kipeh geih a, huchi in Jonathan in ama hinna a-it bang in amah a-it hi.
Saul in huai ni in a-omsak ngal a, apa inn ah apaisak nawnta kei hi.
Huchi in ama hinna bang geih a amah a-it ziak in Jonathan in David toh thu akhung hi.
Jonathan in apuansilh lai asuah a, David apia a, akivatna leh anamsau leh athalpeu leh ataigakna nangawn apia hi.
Saul in asawlna peuh ah David ahoh zel a, kizentak in agamtang hi. Saul in sepaihte heutu in amah abawl a, hiai tuh mi tengteng ngaih in leh Saul sikhate ngaih in ahoih hi.

Ahong pai un hichi ahong hi a, Philistia mi that David ahong pai in Israel kho teng ah numeite lasa leh lam kawm in khuangta leh thil gingtheite toh, nuamsatak in kumpipa Saul dawn ding in ahong pawtkhia uhi.
heading: Saul In David Ahaza

paite: Numeite'n lam kawm ala a kidawngtuah in, "Saul in asang asang athat, David in asing asing," achi uhi.
Hiai lasak in Saul akipaksak kei a, aheh mahmah hi. David bel asing asing that in angai ua, kei ka hihleh asang asang kia that in ahon ngai uh. Kumpigam lou ngal atan ding dang bang ahia om? achi hi.
Saul in huai ni a pan David ahazat bawlta hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, azingsang in Saul tung ah Pathian sawl kha gilou ahong tung a, insung ah thu agen hi. David in nidang a ahih mah bang in kaihging atum hi. Saul in ateipi atawi hi.
Saul in ateipi akhoh a, "Huai baang ah David ka khohden ding," achi hi. David in nihvei akihepkhiaksan hi.
Akiang a ToUPA a-om ziak leh Saul apaisan ziak in Saul in David alau hi.
Huaiziak in Saul in amah a pan akisuansak a, asepaih sangkhat tung a heutu in abawl hi. Huchi in mipi lak ah David lut in apawt zel hi.
David bel ahih peuhmah ah piltak in agamtang zel a; akiang ah TOUPA a-om hi.
Saul in piltak in agamtang chih amuh in alau hi.
Himahleh Israelte leh Judahte tengteng in David a-it uh; alak ua lut a pawt zel lah ahi ngal a.

Saul in David kiang ah, "Ngai in, ka tanu upazaw Merab na zi ding in ka hon neisak ding. Hangtak in hon gum peuhmah lechin. TOUPA kidounate dou in," achi hi. Saul in, "Ke'n zaw atung a khut kha lou in Philistia mite'n atung ah khut kha zaw uhen," achi hi.
heading: David In Saul Tanu Akitenpih

paite: David in Saul kiang ah, "Kua ahia ka hih a, ka hinna leh Israelte lak a ka pa inkuante leng bang ahia ahih uh, kumpipa makpa ka hihna ding?" achi hi,
Himahleh hichi ahong hi a, David toh Saul tanu Merab kitensak ahong hun in, Meholath mi Adriel zi ding in ape mawk hi.
Saul tanu Mikal in David a-it a; Saul ahilh ua; huai in akipaksak hi.

Saul in, "A-awkna ding thang ahong hihtheihna ding leh Philistia mite'n atung a khut akhaktheihna ding un amah ka pe ding," achi hi. Huaiziak in Saul in David kiang ah, "Tuni in ka makpa na hihna ding hunlem anihveina na nei," achi hi.

Huchi in Saul in asikhate thu apia a, "Asimtham in David houpih unla, ngai in, kumpipa na tung ah akipak mahmah a, asikhate tengteng in leng nang ahon it uh. Huchi in kumpipa makpa in om in, chi un," achi hi.
Saul sikhate'n huai thu David bil ah agen uhi. David in, "Mizawng leh kuamah theih phak ngel louh kei a ding in kumpipa makpa hih thil namai in na sep ua hia?" achi hi.
Saul sikhate'n, "David in huchibang in achi," chi in ahilh uh.

Saul in David kiang ah hichibang in na chi ding uh, "Kumpipa'n kumpipa melma phulakna ding in Philistia mite zekvun zakhat chih louh man bangmah adeih kei achi, chi un," achi hi. Saul in David lah Philistia mite khut a sihsak lungsim in anei bikbek hi.
Asikhate'n huai thu David ahilh uleh kumpipa makpa hih David akipak mahmah hi.

Huchi in ni chiamte abei ma in, David leh amite athou ua, Philistia mite zanih ava that uhi. David in azekvun uh ahon pua a, kumpipa makpa ahihtheihna ding in kumpipa kimtak in apia hi. Huchi in Saul in atanu Mikal azi ding in apeta hi.
Saul in David kiang ah Pathian a-om chih atheitelta hi. Saul tanu Mikal in amah a-it hi.
Huchi in Saul in David alau semsem a, Saul bel David melma ahi denta hi.
Philistia' miliante ava kuankhe zel uhi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, akuankhiak peuhmah chiang ua Saul sikha tengteng sang a piltak a David agamtat ziak in amin athang semsem hi.
